transports.description: Home Assistant MCP server (stdio). Requires HA_BASE_URL and HA_TOKEN.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get the current state and attributes of a Home Assistant entity (e.g. light.living_room, sensor.temperature).

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List all entities in the Home Assistant instance, optionally filtered by domain.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service (e.g. light.turn_on, switch.toggle, climate.set_temperature). Triggers real home automation actuation — gates through TLA confirmation.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all available Home Assistant services, optionally filtered by domain.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List all automations defined in the Home Assistant instance.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical state data for an entity over a time range.

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Render a Home Assistant Jinja2 template and return the result. Template is evaluated server-side with full access to HA state, secrets, and system context.

configurableProperties.label: Home Assistant Base URL
configurableProperties.description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance. Example: http://homeassistant.local:8123

configurableProperties.label: Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token
configurableProperties.description: Long-lived access token generated from your HA profile (Profile → Security → Long-Lived Access Tokens). Warning: HA long-lived tokens grant full HA admin access — there is no scope restriction in the HA token model.

checks: build: npm install && npm run build
auth: requires HA_BASE_URL + HA_TOKEN long-lived access token
CVE-2026-32111: SSRF via ha_url in OAuth DCR mode — fixed in v7.0.0; does not affect primary (pre-configured HA_BASE_URL) deployment
trust.notes: Community Home Assistant MCP server. Communicates with a local HA instance over the local network — aligned with the local-first thesis. call_service triggers home automation actuators and requires TLA confirmation. render_template is rated dangerous: Jinja2 templates execute server-side with access to all HA state, secrets, and system context — a prompt-injected template can exfiltrate secrets or trigger destructive automations.
trust.securityNotes: HA long-lived tokens are full-admin — there is no scope restriction in the HA token model. A compromised or stolen HA_TOKEN grants complete Home Assistant control including locks, alarms, and safety systems. Source pinned to v7.0.0 SHA 1f2bbbc74e81933a39e9c63998d1408f0c198309 (fixes CVE-2026-32111 SSRF in OAuth DCR mode). CVE-2026-32111 only affects deployments using the OAuth dynamic client registration flow with attacker-controlled ha_url; primary deployment via pre-configured HA_BASE_URL env var is not affected. HA_TOKEN stored as dmcp secret. Prompt injection risk: HA entity names, automation descriptions, or template results can carry instructions that influence LLM reasoning — treat all HA state as untrusted input.
